newsitem.title: USA: Ella Fitzgerald jazz festival may open in Virginia.
newsitem.headline: Ella Fitzgerald jazz festival may open in Virginia.

text.p: Officials are considering a proposal to fund an annual jazz festival to honour one-time resident Ella Fitzgerald, the late jazz singer, the Newport News Daily Press said Monday.

The proposed Ella Fitzgerald Jazz Extravaganza would feature a performance by at least one major jazz artist and offer clinics and competitions for middle- and high-school students. Mark Reimer, director of music at Christopher Newport University, said it could attract music students from throughout the country.
"What we're hoping for is something similar to the Lionel Hampton Jazz Festival sponsored by the University of Idaho," he told the newspaper. "The primary mission is the education of youth."

City and university officials have been discussing the proposal since the world-renowned singer's death last June. She was born in Newport News in 1918 and her family has indicated its support for a festival.
